Enable external applications to inspect intermediate script execution step-by-step for debuggers and analyzers
Allow interpreter tests and fuzzing to observe execution states before later errors shadow unexpected behavior

why: P3 because it adds an auxiliary diagnostic feature to libbitcoinkernel rather than core consensus decoupling
Enables external tools like script debuggers, visualizers, and analyzers to inspect opcode state
Carries zero runtime overhead in default builds where tracing macros compile to no-ops
